messages:
maria: quick follow-up on the consolidated lease idea. want to capture immediate ops/compliance edges before i update RFC.

jon: main wins: less ledger write amplification, single cleanup path. risk: cross-tenant contention and scaling hotspot.

sam: auditors need an immutable trace for every token movement. shared lease ok if we emit deterministic acquisition events keyed by claim_id.

lee: latency: runtimes should do small optimistic local_prefetch and emit an envelope; shared service reconciles async. example envelope inlined in thread.

maria: fallback if lease service is down? and preventing double-counting when prefetched tokens are later denied?

jon: fallback options: local ephemeral lease with short TTL + mark fallback in audit, degraded capacity routing, or fail fast. prefer ephemeral + compensating events.

sam: agreed. treat compensations as first-class: emit prefetch_claim then prefetch_revoke if denied. billing uses claim_id as dedupe key.

lee: implementation notes: commitlog topic keyed by tenant for ordering; reconciler consumes and writes compacted balance entries. keep a small in-memory window for pending prefetches.

maria: interface boundaries to formalize: runtime->lease API (fast accept/revoke + prefetch) and lease->audit (immutable, ordered, dedupe).

jon: metrics: prefetch_accept_rate, prefetch_revoke_rate, reconcile_lag, claim_dedupe_rate. set alerts on revoke spikes.

deploy-bot: canary deploy lease-service-v1 started in us-west-2 (3 pods) | logs: https://logs.internal/lease/6866660001

sam: auditors want 90d minimal provenance; plan for enterprise 1y. archive older proofs to long-term storage.

lee: trade: virtual per-tenant shards vs shared keying. shards avoid noisy neighbors but complicate resharding. leaning shards for predictable tails.

maria: action items: jon->fallback doc + reconciler SLA; lee->event contracts and sample compacted ledger; sam->retention/archive plan; i'll run perf spikes for local_prefetch knobs and post numbers.

jon: noted. sam: quick: include regional differences (NA/EU retention).

sam: will do.

maria: thanks, tagging RFC board. :thumbsup:
